hooks.name: Auto-Document React Components
hooks.description: Automatically adds JSDoc and inline documentation to TypeScript/React files on save

action.prompt:
Review the file that was just saved. If it's a React component or TypeScript module that lacks proper JSDoc comments or inline documentation, add comprehensive documentation including:
- Component/function purpose and description
- @param descriptions for all parameters
- @returns description
- Usage examples where helpful
- Any important implementation notes

Focus on clarity and completeness. Only add documentation if it's missing or incomplete.
